headline: Tightening Tax on Abandoned Land: "Spotlighting" Wasteful Projects, Handing Them to Capable Enterprises
summary: Vietnam's Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment proposes amending the Land Law to tax abandoned real estate. The aim is to curb speculation and transfer wasteful projects to capable enterprises.
why: Land taxes and land-use rules affect property developers, land values and real estate supply, which matter to investors in Vietnam's property market.
